title: Web Developer or Web Designer: Which Do You Need? | X-Traordinary
h1: Do You Need a Web Developer or a Web Designer?
description: Designer, developer, or both? A plain-English guide to figuring out which one your website or software project actually needs, plus what to ask before you hire.
excerpt: Most small business projects need both skills, but rarely in equal measure. Here is how to tell which one your project actually hinges on before you start calling people.

cta.h2: Not sure which one your project needs?
cta.text: Tell us what is broken or what you are trying to build, and we will tell you straight, including if the answer is that you do not need us.

title: WordPress vs. a Custom-Coded Website: Which Is Right for Your Business?
description: An honest comparison of WordPress and custom-coded websites for small and mid-size businesses – speed, security, SEO, cost over five years, and who should choose which.
excerpt: WordPress powers a huge share of the web for good reasons – and creates most of the slow, hacked, unmaintainable sites we get asked to rescue. Here is how to decide.

cta.h2: Not sure which one fits your business?
cta.text: Send us your current site or a description of the new one. We will tell you honestly which approach makes sense – even when the answer is WordPress.
